appearance.title: Booking page appearance
appearance.subtitle: Make the page your customers use to book an appointment look like your business.
appearance.forbidden: You do not have permission to view the booking page appearance.
appearance.notAvailable: The booking page appearance is not available on this server yet.
appearance.readOnly: You can look at the appearance but not change it. Changing it needs permission to edit booking types.
appearance.issues: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention before you can save.} other {# fields need attention before you can save.}}

conflict.message: The appearance was changed by someone else while you were editing.

leave.title: Leave without saving?
leave.message: Your changes to the booking page appearance have not been saved.

tile.label: Booking page appearance
tile.description: Logo, colours, fonts and welcome text of the page customers book on
tile.keywords: branding, logo, colours, theme, booking page, look and feel, fonts, white label

card.title: Booking page appearance
card.description: Add your logo and colours, write a welcome message and choose fonts and corners for the page customers book on. You see a live preview as you edit.

editorLink.saveFirst: Save the booking type first, then open its page appearance.

pictures.title: Logo and cover image
pictures.description: Shown at the top of the page. Leave them empty to use what is set higher up.
pictures.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to {mb} MB. A wide logo on a transparent background works best.
pictures.coverHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, up to {mb} MB. Shown as a banner when the background is set to cover image.
pictures.useBrand: Use my Branding logo and colours when empty
pictures.useBrandHint: Anything you leave empty here is taken from Settings, Branding, so the booking page matches the rest of your brand.

fields.inheritedPicture: Using the one set higher up.
fields.pictureType: Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF image.
fields.pictureSize: The picture is too large. The limit is {mb} MB.
fields.pictureRejected: That picture was not accepted. Use a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF image within the size limit.

colours.title: Colours and background
colours.description: Text colours are chosen for you so that everything stays readable.
colours.buttonHint: The colour of buttons and selected times. Empty uses the primary colour.
colours.backgroundHint: Solid colour, a soft tint of your primary colour, or your cover image as a banner.
colours.needCover: Upload a cover image to use this background.

checks.title: Readability checks
checks.autoText: Text on your buttons is black or white, whichever reads better, and your primary colour is darkened or lightened where it is used as text.
checks.primaryText: Your primary colour has a contrast of {ratio}:1 on the page, below {min}:1, so it is adjusted where it is used as text.
checks.button: Button text has a contrast of {ratio}:1 on your button colour, below {min}:1.
checks.buttonEdge: Your button colour has a contrast of {ratio}:1 against the page, below {min}:1, so buttons may be hard to see.

wording.title: Wording
wording.description: Plain text only. Customers see it in the language you write it in.
wording.pageTitleHint: Shown at the top of the page and in the browser tab. Empty uses your business name.
wording.welcomeHint: {count} of {max} characters. Shown above the booking form.
wording.buttonHint: The text on the final button, for example Reserve my spot. Requests that need approval keep their own label.

style.title: Fonts and corners
style.description: A small set of safe choices that work on every device.
style.fontHint: These use fonts already on the customer's device, so the page loads quickly.

options.title: Page options
options.description: What else appears around the booking form.
options.languageHint: Lets customers change the language of the page.
options.poweredByHint: Switch it off to show only your own brand.
options.poweredByLocked: Removing "Powered by" is part of white-label branding, which your plan does not include.

links.title: Page address
links.description: Where customers open the page. Changes show there as soon as you save.
links.later: Using your own domain, and placing the page inside another website, are not available yet.

type.title: Page appearance: {name}
type.subtitle: Give this booking type its own logo, colours or welcome message. Anything you leave empty uses the workspace appearance.
type.notFound: This booking type no longer exists.
type.resetDescription: Removes everything set for this booking type, including its pictures.
type.resetConfirmMessage: The logo, cover image, colours and wording set for this booking type will be removed.
type.resetDone: This booking type now uses the workspace appearance

preview.title: Live preview
preview.note: This is the real page with sample times. Nothing you do here is booked.
preview.sampleDescription: A short call to understand what you need and answer your questions.
preview.sampleIntro: Please arrive a few minutes early.
